title: EV Road Trip Charge Stop Dwell Time
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=evcharger:session trip_mode=road_trip
| stats avg(stop_duration_min) as avg_stop_duration_min, max(stop_duration_min) as max_stop_duration_min by site_name
| where avg_stop_duration_min>45
| sort - avg_stop_duration_min
description: Uses Road-trip charging sessions telemetry to monitor how long stops actually take on travel days in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for sites or workflows that keep stretching the journey, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Road-trip charging sessions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Charging-site table of average stop duration.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how long stops actually take on travel days so you can spot sites or workflows that keep stretching the journey before it becomes annoying.
